paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of Nb–16Si alloys with Zr additions
paper_metadata.journal: International Journal of Refractory Metals and Hard Materials

evidence.quote: To optimize the microstructure and fracture toughness of Nb–Si based alloys, the effect of Zr addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties was investigated in Nb–16Si alloy.
The nominal compositions of Nb–Si based alloys employed in this paper are Nb–16Si, Nb-16Si-1Zr, Nb-16Si-2Zr, Nb-16Si-4Zr and Nb-16Si-8Zr, respectively.
